prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a parking lot collision. The patient had 23 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1298; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a low-speed rear-end collision in a parking lot and reported neck pain, stiffness, and occasional headaches radiating to the base of the skull. Cervical range of motion was reduced in flexion and rotation, with paraspinal muscle tenderness and mild spasm noted on examination. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no motor deficits, sensory changes, or reflex asymmetry. A diagnosis of cervical strain consistent with whiplash-associated disorder was made.

Over the course of 23 visits, treatment consisted of manual therapy, targeted therapeutic exercise for deep neck flexors and scapular stabilizers, and instruction in a home exercise program and ergonomic posture. Modalities including heat and intermittent cold were used for symptom control during the acute and subacute phases. Pain intensity and functional limitations were monitored at each visit using standardized neck disability questionnaires.

Progress has been steady. Range of motion has improved substantially, headache frequency has decreased, and the patient is now performing most daily activities without significant restriction. Residual intermittent stiffness persists with prolonged computer use and driving. Continued self-directed home exercise is recommended, with follow-up as needed for flare-ups. Return to full unrestricted activity is anticipated within the next several weeks.
